name: Forza Horizon 2
notes:
WHAT THIS RECIPE IS. A record of how the game is set up on the handheld as of 2026-11-06, not an improvement on it: applying it there changes nothing on the main account. Facts below were read from that machine unless they say otherwise. The second account's entry, "Forza Horizon 2 (Azimuth)", is matched through aliases and brought into line with the main one. The appid pin 3451071415 is also what crc32("gfm:forza-horizon-2-azimuth") | 0x80000000 gives, so the two agree only while the recipe id stays the same.

AZIMUTH 1.0.4 (almost-there-games.itch.io/azimuth) is a WRAPPER, not a port: it translates Xbox WinRT calls to Win32 and Xbox D3D11 to desktop D3D12, so the Xbox One build of Forza Horizon 2 runs on a PC. The game never had a PC release. There is no Linux build; it runs through Proton, and vkd3d-proton does the heavy lifting. azimuth.exe is 8,613,376 bytes, sha256 56d2c9cb6ccf3ae1836dee9676b64285f3a247efa2d12cf02c6c742696b3b092. data/logs/azimuth.log reads "Azimuth 1.0.4 (azimuth.exe) on Wine 10.0 (wine-10.0 (Staging)), Proton ... GE-Proton10-34" for every session from 2026-11-01 on. It carries its own runtimes in data/bin (msvcp110, msvcr110, msvcp140, vcruntime140), so there is no vcrun install in the prefix. Offline only: no Xbox Live. There is no in-game quit, so exit with the Steam button.

THE GATE IS THE GAME EXE'S SHA-256, AND 1.0.0.64 IS HOW YOU GET THE RIGHT ONE. Azimuth pins hashes and refuses anything else with "Game executable hash mismatch" or "Not a folder of a supported game" (both read from the 0.9.9 binary; not re-read on 1.0.4). A differently packaged 1.0.0.64 can still be refused. From the dump's Mount/AppxManifest.xml: Identity Name="Anthem" Version="1.0.0.64", TitleId 1A96545B. "Anthem" is FH2's internal package name, so a folder called Anthem_1.0.0.64_x64__8wekyb3d8bbwe IS Forza Horizon 2 and is not mislabelled.

LAYOUT MATTERS. The package folder must be whole: era.vbi + Mount/ + EmbeddedXvd/, all three. EmbeddedXvd holds EmbeddedXvd/Windows/System32/xg_x.dll, the Xbox tiling library the translation needs. The game exe is Mount/forza_durango_release_final.exe, LOWERCASE on disk while AppxManifest.xml declares it mixed-case. On btrfs that is a different path, so never retype it from the manifest. Azimuth's own data/ folder must sit beside azimuth.exe.

data/azimuth.ini: NEVER POINT ini_edit AT IT. It is UTF-16LE with a BOM and CRLF line endings. ini_edit reads and writes utf-8 with surrogateescape and joins lines with \n, so nothing raises: it reports success and leaves a file that no longer decodes as UTF-16 (reproduced on a copy 2026-10-15). It goes in save_paths as a plain byte-for-byte copy. To change it, use Azimuth's launcher or something that keeps the BOM and CRLF.

THE LAUNCHER PATHS ARE ABSOLUTE NOW. The ini holds folder=Z:\run\media\deck\SD_Card\Games\Forza Horizon 2\Anthem_1.0.0.64_x64__8wekyb3d8bbwe, the same form for the Fast & Furious title, and content= for Storm Island in that form followed by *<64 hex digits>, an id that also names a folder under data/titles/1A96545B/art. The relative folder names of the 0.9.9 days are gone. No step touches these paths, and none should. Azimuth also sees the card as D:\Games (Extra Options logs that form): Wine creates that drive itself for a mounted card, so no step is needed.

CONTENT PACKAGES. The base dump contains neither expansion. StormIsland_1.0.0.36_neutral__8wekyb3d8bbwe (3.02 GiB) is a content package: AppxManifest.xml at its root, no era.vbi, wired in through content= under [title-1a96545b]. Spire_1.0.0.6_x64__8wekyb3d8bbwe (14.85 GiB) is a separate game image, "Forza Horizon 2 Presents Fast & Furious", TitleId 5A9771A4, with its own [title-5a9771a4] section. The third-party FH2 DLC Launcher.exe + fh2core.dll are redundant: do not install them.

THE BASE DUMP IS ONE FILE SHORT. media/_library/textures.zip (~45.7 MB) is listed by the game's zipmanifest.xml but absent, and the exe does mount that root. Impact is probably cosmetic. Azimuth cannot warn about it, so a clean azimuth.log proves nothing about dump completeness.

TWO PIPELINE CACHES, and only one is disposable. data/bin/azimuth.pipelines (11.4 MB on 1.0.4) is SHIPPED by the author and belongs to Azimuth. data/cache/pipelines-<vendor>-<device>-....bin is GENERATED and keyed by GPU: the 1002-150e file is this handheld's, and the 91.6 MB 10de-2684 file is a leftover from an NVIDIA desktop, harmless and left in place. data/cache/translated-*.pack (74 MB) is keyed by game, not GPU.

SAVES. {game_dir}/data/titles/1A96545B/saves is verified: player-1/User_9000000000000/revisions held 00000000000001a7 and 00000000000001a8 on 2026-11-06, each with a commit marker. Azimuth keeps only the latest TWO revisions, so everything older is already gone from the device, which is why a capture matters. {game_dir}/data/titles/5A9771A4/saves does not exist yet and is UNVERIFIED: Fast & Furious has never saved here, and the path is inferred from the FH2 folder. Nothing save-like was in the prefix when checked on 2026-10-15. The mod files in save_paths are the owner's state, not payload: FH2_ExtraOptions.ini and .dat, mods/loadorder.txt, Spotify Radio's config.ini (station = 7, the shipped default is 3), fh2-mods/Achievements.ini, fh2-mods/Achievements/User_9000000000000.ini (counters the save does not keep, per the mod's README) and communitygarage/account.ini (the login key for the community server; the mod says that losing it loses control of your uploads). account.ini is secret: it goes to the NAS with the saves and must never be copied into this repo.

EXTRA OPTIONS 0.4.4 IS A winmm.dll PROXY NOW. The live build is identified by the first line of FH2_ExtraOptions.log ("Forza Horizon 2 Extra Options 0.4.4") and by hash: winmm.dll (578,560 bytes, sha256 c69697d015416973fdd763005bbe23d5b68f9c8acfef1165db0bbf02b8493213) and all 23 files under mods/Extra Options - Garage Revving and mods/Extra Options - Weather Control match the Azimuth/ folder of FH2_Extra_Options_0.4.4-azimuth.zip byte for byte. That zip is release Azimuth_v1.0.0 of github.com/RokkuDayo/ForzaHorizon2_ExtraOptions (GPL-3.0). The mod no longer replaces data/bin/azimuth-tls.dll, which is the stock 4,608-byte file again (sha256 ffa229b6c62228bf6126de6f140c6a70326c536524bec00f9304ac6591805bb7). It sits next to azimuth.exe, which is why the launch options carry WINEDLLOVERRIDES="winmm.dll=n,b". It works under Proton: the log shows "OK: requested tweaks applied in memory." and "AZIMUTH: 1.0.4 initialized for FH2 (1A96545B); native game loader and TLS retained." The log, ini and dat all live in the game folder now, not data/bin.

DO NOT COPY THE SHIPPED FH2_ExtraOptions.ini. The live one differs from the zip's in two lines: DisableAzimuthSaveChecksums=0 and LocalDrivatarLiveries=0, where the zip has 1 for both. Copying it over would switch off Azimuth's save checks, which the log currently reports as enabled. So no step writes the ini, and it comes back through save_paths. Its header says v0.3.2 even inside the 0.4.4 zip; that is upstream's text, not a sign of an old install. Do not use ini_edit on it either: it is CRLF, and ini_edit rewrites LF-only. FH2_ExtraOptions.dat (164 bytes) is in no zip: the mod writes it at run time from the in-game menus. Gamerpic.png is gone: 0.4.4 does not ship it, upstream says Azimuth has its own profile pictures, the log says CustomGamerpic=0, and the only copy is a disabled leftover, so it left save_paths. data/bin/*.mod-disabled and azimuth-tls.dll.gfm-orig are leftovers of the 0.2.74 install and nothing loads them.

FH2 MOD PLATFORM 2.8.0 (github.com/Trinculo54/fh2-mod-platform, MIT) is DWrite.dll, and d3dcompiler_47.dll is the same file; fh2-mods/platform.log says "loaded as DWrite.dll". It loads every DLL in fh2-mods. The live bytes (sha256 0fd0f5ad64d777b6230c5d82b668f8954048565d3e6573a5460afc26e636385f) are NOT those in the platform's own v2.8.0 zip (a7db4a14...). They are the copies inside Achievements-v1.0.2.zip, so that is the source here. Every mod zip carries its own platform and they differ: CommunityGarage-1.2.1.zip has 4618231a..., and the UpgradeBasket zip has an older 2.7.3 build. Take these two files from the Achievements bundle only.

PREFIX OVERRIDES. user.reg holds [Software\\Wine\\AppDefaults\\azimuth.exe\\DllOverrides] with "dwrite" and "winmm" = "native,builtin", added by hand at the 2026-11-01 install for the platform. The launch options cover winmm only. The wine_registry step mirrors this; it is optional because a fresh prefix needs one launch first, then a second Apply.

WHAT IS MIRRORED, AND FROM WHERE. Every file was compared by sha256 with the live copy on 2026-11-06.
From public releases (remote_payloads, plus a copy on the NAS at the same relative path):
 - Extra Options 0.4.4: winmm.dll and the two add-on folders under mods.
 - Achievements 1.0.2 (github.com/Trinculo54/fh2-achievements): DWrite.dll, d3dcompiler_47.dll, fh2-mods/Achievements.dll.
 - Community Garage 1.2.1 (github.com/qiangqiang101/CommunityGarage, MIT): fh2-mods/CommunityGarage.dll, communitygarage/server.ini. It reaches a community server over the internet.
 - Spotify Radio 0.4.0 ExtraOptions Edition (github.com/RussFactorShow/FH2-Streaming-Radio): mod.json, README.txt, the plugin, the licences file and the logo, file by file so config.ini is never overwritten.
From the NAS only, under payload/private (gitignored, so these never reach git), with optional steps so a machine without the NAS still applies the rest:
 - fh2-mods/UpgradeBasket.dll 1.1.0: no public release found.
 - mods: 20 ZS Forza Motorsport 5 car packs plus ZS FM5 Common, Furious 7 Extra Car Pack, Gumpert Apollo S, Lamborghini Murcielago LP640, Porsche 911 GT3 RS (992), 118 cars in all, and Free Fast Travel. The car packs are game-derived, which is why they stay off git. Free Fast Travel is a local build (author "local" in mod.json), a 5,632-byte plugin that makes fast travel free in memory and changes no save. As of 2026-11-06 none of the seven cars in the garage is a mod car (Career_Garage in the save's PlayerDatabase), so the save does not depend on the packs yet; they are mirrored because they are part of the setup.
 - The soundtrack: three HZ2_MX_Radio_0N_Tracks.bank files and ten RadioInfo_*.xml, overwritten inside Anthem_.../Mount/media/audio at the 2026-11-01 install ("Horizon Remixed", 442 MB). The package folder is therefore not stock. Apply keeps a .gfm-orig only when it really replaces a different file. On this install those 13 files were overwritten by hand and already match, so no .gfm-orig exists for them.
The old 0.2.74 files on the NAS under payload/fix/Azimuth are no longer used by this recipe.

LEFT OUT, AND WHY. azimuth.exe, data/bin, data/licenses.txt and the three package folders: licensed or game files, never shipped by this recipe, apart from the 13 third-party soundtrack files above. Spotify Radio's cache/credentials.json, device_id.txt and volume: a login token and device state, so they are neither mirrored nor in save_paths; link the phone again after a reimage. Generated at run time: data/cache, data/logs, data/titles/*/art, data/titles/*/tmp, data/titles/*/pipeline-log.bin, FH2_ExtraOptions.log, spotify-radio.log, fh2-mods/platform*, platform-logs, notices, and fh2-mods/Achievements/Achievements.log, Achievements.txt and cache. Anthem_.../Mount/mediaoverride (28 files, 620 KB) appears to belong here too: platform.log says it wrote UpgradeCar.str there and the file times follow session starts, but regeneration has not been tested. Old copies nothing reads: fh2-mods/Achievements/User_9000000000000.ini.bak, azimuth.exe.1.0.0, azimuth.exe.pre-1.0, data/bin.1.0.0, data/bin.pre-1.0, data/azimuth.ini.* and the .mod-disabled files.

FRAME GENERATION. ~/.lsfg in the launch options is a shell wrapper written by the Decky LSFG-VK plugin (marker "# lsfg-vk-wrapper-format: 2"). It has a case for appid 3451071415, and the plugin's profile for this game is multiplier 2, flow scale 1.0, vsync pacing. No recipe installs it, and a reimage removes it. Until it exists the launch line points at a missing file, so the game cannot start. post_apply_message says so.

APPLY CAN ABORT ON A DOWNLOAD. Apply runs the fetch before any step, and a failed fetch stops it. The Extra Options author renames tags and replaces assets in place: the 0.2.74 zip moved from tag Release to Azimuth_v0.9.9, and the 0.4.4 asset was re-uploaded on 2026-10-29. If a URL 404s or a hash stops matching, update url, sha256 and size, or delete that entry: the NAS copy still satisfies the steps, because payload_path prefers it per file. These zips are third-party binaries, GPL-3.0 in Extra Options' case, so they are fetched and never committed: payload/downloads and payload/bundle are gitignored.

THE NAS COPY OF THE GAME IS OUT OF DATE. _games/Forza Horizon 2 still has the pre-1.0 azimuth.exe (3,475,968 bytes) and no mods, so a deploy from it does not reproduce this install. Re-stage it before relying on it.

REVERT removes every mirrored file that has no .gfm-orig beside it, and the two registry values, so it strips the mod stack from the game folder. That includes the 13 soundtrack files inside the package: on an install where the soundtrack was already in place they have no .gfm-orig, so Revert deletes them and they must be copied back from a stock copy of the game. Files in save_paths stay.
post_apply_message:
Forza Horizon 2 is in Steam as azimuth.exe on GE-Proton10-34, with the main account's launch options. The Azimuth 1.0.4 files and the game itself are not installed by this recipe.

AFTER A REIMAGE, BEFORE THE FIRST LAUNCH: the launch options call ~/.lsfg, the frame generation wrapper. The Decky LSFG-VK plugin writes it and no recipe restores it, so the game will not start until it exists. Install the plugin and give this game a profile (app id 3451071415, multiplier 2, flow scale 1.0). Its config points at the Lossless Scaling app in Steam, so that must be installed too. To play without frame generation, remove ~/.lsfg from the launch options and leave the rest.

ON A NEW PREFIX: launch once, quit, and Apply again. The dwrite and winmm overrides can only be written once the prefix exists.

RESTORE SAVES AS WELL. These come back with the saves, not with Apply: the career save, data/azimuth.ini, FH2_ExtraOptions.ini and .dat, mods/loadorder.txt, Spotify Radio's config.ini, Achievements progress and communitygarage/account.ini. Without the restore, Extra Options has no ini at all, and do not fetch one from its zip: the shipped file switches Azimuth's save checks off. Without account.ini, Community Garage makes you a new player.

Spotify Radio needs linking again from the phone (Spotify Connect device "Forza Horizon 2"). Its station is 7, set in config.ini.

Car packs, UpgradeBasket, Free Fast Travel and the soundtrack come from the NAS. If the NAS was not mounted, those steps are skipped with a message: mount it and Apply again.

Controller bindings from Extra Options:
  D-Pad Down  - autodrive (set a GPS route first; press again, or steer, accelerate, brake or pause, to take control back). F2 on a keyboard.
  D-Pad Up  - hazards.
  D-Pad Left/Right, hold  - turn signals.
  Right stick, click  - lights, any car.
  Right stick, hold while stationary  - roof.

No in-game quit: use the Steam button.
